WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_cost_difference
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Products AS p
    ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories AS pc
    ON pc.production_type_code = p.production_type_code
  GROUP BY pc.product_type_description
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_cost_difference) AS overall_avg_cost_difference
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT
    s1.avg_quantity,
    s1.avg_cost_difference,
    s1.avg_cost_difference - s2.overall_avg_cost_difference AS difference_from_overall
  FROM step1 AS s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2
  WHERE s1.avg_cost_difference > s2.overall_avg_cost_difference
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_quantity,
  AVG(avg_cost_difference) AS avg_cost_difference,
  AVG(difference_from_overall) AS avg_difference_from_overall
FROM step3
